captions.title: Contact and friction
captions.body: Same robot, same squeeze, same motion. Only the cube's surface changes.

captions.title: High friction (μ = 1.0)
captions.body: Friction between fingers and cube holds its weight: carried and placed

captions.title: Lower friction (μ = 0.3)
captions.body: Think of a wet or oily surface, gripped with the same force

captions.title: Slip!
captions.body: Friction can't hold the weight on the move: the cube slides out and drops

captions.title: Slow motion
captions.body: To hold an object, grip force × friction must beat its weight and motion
